definitions.gloss: to hold out, to endure, to withstand
definitions.explanation: To continue to resist or survive under difficult conditions; to hang on despite hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なんとか→なんとか：01126_nantoka⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}えた。
examples.english: The company somehow managed to hold out through the recession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm worried whether the levee will hold against the flood.

examples.japanese: ⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}えれば、⟦{救援|きゅうえん}→救援：07864_kyuuen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If we can just hold out a little longer, help will arrive.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). The subject is whatever is holding out, marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ or ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧.

PARTICLES: Although the verb is intransitive, the hardship weathered is regularly marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える, 'weather the recession') — a traversal ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ rather than a true direct object. The pressure resisted can also be marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) + ⟦{堪|こた}える→堪える：noentry⟧ (to endure). The combination emphasizes sustained endurance or resistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える (weather a recession)
・⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える (withstand an attack)
・⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える (endure hardships)
・⟦なんとか→なんとか：01126_nantoka⟧{持|も}ち{堪|こた}える (somehow hold out)

SIMILAR WORDS: ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ emphasizes bearing pain or difficulty; {持|も}ち{堪|こた}える emphasizes maintaining a position or continuing to function. ⟦{堪|こら}える→堪える：08995_koraeru⟧ (same kanji, read こらえる) is a different verb meaning to hold back a feeling or urge.
